title: Studio: "Add item" on a dashboard list property autosaves an empty item (422), and every later edit is refused and lost until reload
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types acceptance[4]). The item's own knownGaps names this with no open card.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. Create a writable package and a dashboard in it, then open `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces` and select the dashboard.
2. Properties → "Filters" → Global Filters → "Add item". Use the last "Add item" button; the first belongs to header Actions.
3. Leave the new item empty and edit the dashboard Label.
4. Expected: an incomplete item is held client-side (not autosaved) until it validates, and the label edit persists.
5. Actual: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME?mode=draft&package=PKG&surface=studio` carries `globalFilters[N] = {}` → 422 "globalFilters.N.field [invalid_type]". The following label PUT carries the same empty item and is also 422. After a reload the label edit is gone. Edits made before the Add item survive. Reproduced three times on fresh loads.
6. Same class: header "Actions › Add item" autosaves an empty action → 422 "header.actions.0.label [invalid_union]; header.actions.0.actionUrl [invalid_type]".

7. Same class on the report Properties panel: Order "Add item" → PUT `order:[{}]` → 422 `order.0.by`; choosing chart type "bar" before axes → 422 `chart.xAxis`/`chart.yAxis`; joined "Add item" → `blocks:[{}]` → 422. Each shows the red "Changes not saved: the server refused this draft" banner instead of holding the edit as the other pillars do.

## Mechanism
The array editor appends a schema-incomplete `{}` to the authored document, and autosave sends the whole document. Every subsequent save then fails on the same element, so unrelated edits are silently lost. #26705 covered edits held while leaving a pillar; this is the held-forever case created by a blank list item.
